## Verification

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope and acceptance criteria are satisfied, or remaining work is explicit.
- [ ] Public documentation matches the change; proposed features remain labeled proposed.
- [ ] Arabic/English and RTL/LTR impacts are addressed where applicable.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, private context, real user data or generated artifacts.
- [ ] Security/privacy/dependency changes cite the relevant decision and limitations.
